categories.name: Removal Order Damaged
categories.sampleFormat:
Removal Order ID: [e.g. 260601191A]
Tracking ID (AWB): [carrier tracking number]
FC ID: [fulfillment center id]
Case ID: [case id]
FNSKU / LPN of damaged item: [e.g. X002EKIG17]
Quantity: [number of damaged units]

Mandatory attachments:
- Unboxing Video (from receiving package to opening each item)
- Product images: all 6 sides of box + damage close-up
- Images of tracking labels / packing slips

Optional:
- Copy of POD noting damage on receipt
- CCTV recording if available

categories.name: Removal - Missing Units / Switcheroo / Main Item Missing
categories.sampleFormat:
1. Issue type: [Missing Accessory / Main Unit Missing / Switcheroo / Short Shipment]
2. SPS Case ID: [case id from SPS]
3. Within claim window (Yes/No): Yes
4. Removal Order ID: [e.g. 260601191A]
5. FC ID: [fulfillment center id]
6. Tracking ID (AWB): [carrier tracking]
7. LPN and FNSKU: [e.g. X002EKIG17 - 1 unit missing]
8. Quantity: [total units missing]
9. Unboxing Video: Attached [or paste Google Drive link]

Optional (helpful):
- Copy of POD

categories.name: Missing From Inbound (MFI)
categories.sampleFormat:
Shipment ID: [e.g. FBA15LRHVTK2]
Merchant ID: [your seller merchant id]
SPS Case ID: [case id from SPS]
FNSKU and claim Quantity:
  - [FNSKU 1] - [X units missing]
  - [FNSKU 2] - [X units missing]

Required documents (attach, based on carrier type):
- If Partnered Carrier: Tracking ID + STN / Delivery Challan
- If Non-Partnered: EPOD + STN with FC stamp (all pages, full-size scans)
- If shipment value > INR 50,000: Invoice / Proof of Purchase

Pre-submission checks (mark Yes/No):
- Duplicate check: [Yes/No]
- Valid POD: [Yes/No]
- Invoice created with actual ASIN: [Yes/No]
- Cross match: [Yes/No]
